title: पञ्चचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 145 · Ghatotkacha carries them to Badari

summary.en: Ghatotkacha and his Rakshasas carry the Pandavas, Draupadi and the Brahmins through the sky to the hermitage of Nara and Narayana at Badari. There, by the Ganga, the brothers rest happily and enjoy watching Draupadi delight in the beauty of the place.
summary.kn: ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚ ಮತ್ತು ಅವನ ರಾಕ್ಷಸರು ಪಾಂಡವರು, ದ್ರೌಪದಿ, ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರನ್ನು ಆಕಾಶಮಾರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದರಿಯ ನರನಾರಾಯಣಾಶ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊತ್ತೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಗಾತೀರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹೋದರರು ಸಂತೋಷದಿಂದ ವಿಶ್ರಮಿಸಿ ಸ್ಥಳದ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ಆನಂದಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಸುಖಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: घटोत्कच और उसके राक्षस पाण्डवों, द्रौपदी और ब्राह्मणों को आकाश मार्ग से बदरी में नर-नारायण के आश्रम ले जाते हैं। वहाँ गंगा-तट पर भाई सुख से विश्राम करते हैं और द्रौपदी को स्थान की शोभा में आनन्द लेते देखकर प्रसन्न होते हैं।
summary.te: ఘటోత్కచుడు, అతని రాక్షసులు పాండవులను, ద్రౌపదిని, బ్రాహ్మణులను ఆకాశమార్గంలో బదరిలోని నరనారాయణాశ్రమానికి మోసుకువెళ్తారు. అక్కడ గంగాతీరంలో సోదరులు సంతోషంగా విశ్రమించి ఆ ప్రదేశ సౌందర్యంలో ద్రౌపది ఆనందించడం చూసి సంతోషిస్తారు.
summary.ta: கடோத்கசனும் அவன் அரக்கர்களும் பாண்டவர்களையும் திரௌபதியையும் அந்தணர்களையும் வான் வழியாகப் பதரியிலுள்ள நரநாராயண ஆசிரமத்துக்குச் சுமந்து செல்கிறார்கள். அங்குக் கங்கைக் கரையில் சகோதரர்கள் மகிழ்வுடன் ஓய்வெடுத்து, இடத்தின் அழகில் திரௌபதி மகிழ்வதைக் கண்டு இன்புறுகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: ഘടോത്കചനും അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ രാക്ഷസന്മാരും പാണ്ഡവരെയും ദ്രൗപദിയെയും ബ്രാഹ്മണരെയും ആകാശമാർഗത്തിലൂടെ ബദരിയിലെ നരനാരായണാശ്രമത്തിൽ എത്തിക്കുന്നു. അവിടെ ഗംഗാതീരത്ത് സഹോദരന്മാർ സന്തോഷത്തോടെ വിശ്രമിക്കുന്നു; ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്റെ സൗന്ദര്യത്തിൽ ദ്രൗപദി ആനന്ദിക്കുന്നത് അവർ കണ്ടാസ്വദിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.145; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
धर्मज्ञो बलवाञ्शूरः सद्यो राक्षसपुंगवः ।
भक्तोऽस्मानौरसः पुत्रो भीम गृह्णातु मातरम् ॥

meaning.en: Bhima, this chief of demons, who knows dharma, is strong and brave, and is devoted to us, our true son. Let him take his mother.

verses.text:
तव भीम बलेनाहमतिभीमपराक्रम ।
अक्षतः सह पाञ्चाल्या गच्छेयं गन्धमादनम् ॥

meaning.en: Bhima, of fearsome prowess, by your strength let me go, unharmed, with Panchali to Gandhamadana.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
भ्रातुर्वचनमाज्ञाय भीमसेनो घटोत्कचम् ।
आदिदेश नरव्याघ्रस्तनयं शत्रुकर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: Understanding his brother's words, Bhimasena, tiger among men, instructed his son, the destroyer of foes, Ghatotkacha.

verses.text:
हैडिम्बेय परिश्रान्ता तव मातापराजिता ।
त्वं च कामगमस्तात बलवान्वह तां खग ॥

meaning.en: Son of Hidimba, your mother is tired and unconquered. You, my son, can go where you wish and are strong, bird. Carry her.

verses.text:
स्कन्धमारोप्य भद्रं ते मध्येऽस्माकं विहायसा ।
गच्छ नीचिकया गत्या यथा चैनां न पीडयेः ॥

meaning.en: Blessings on you. Place her on your shoulder and fly through the sky in the midst of us, going low so that you do not hurt her.

verses.text: घटोत्कच उवाच

meaning.en: Ghatotkacha said:

verses.text:
धर्मराजं च धौम्यं च राजपुत्रीं यमौ तथा ।
एकोऽप्यहमलं वोढुं किमुताद्य सहायवान् ॥

meaning.en: I alone am able to carry the king of dharma, Dhaumya, the princess and the twins, much more so now with helpers.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा ततः कृष्णामुवाह स घटोत्कचः ।
पाण्डूनां मध्यगो वीरः पाण्डवानपि चापरे ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, Ghatotkacha lifted Krishna, the hero going in the middle of the Pandavas, and other demons carried the Pandavas.

verses.text:
लोमशः सिद्धमार्गेण जगामानुपमद्युतिः ।
स्वेनैवात्मप्रभावेन द्वितीय इव भास्करः ॥

meaning.en: Lomasha, of unequalled brilliance, went by the path of the siddhas, by his own power like a second sun.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणांश्चापि तान्सर्वान्समुपादाय राक्षसाः ।
नियोगाद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य जग्मुर्भीमपराक्रमाः ॥

meaning.en: Taking up all those brahmins too, the demons of fearsome prowess went at the order of their king of demons.

verses.text:
एवं सुरमणीयानि वनान्युपवनानि च ।
आलोकयन्तस्ते जग्मुर्विशालां बदरीं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: So, gazing at the lovely forests and groves, they went on toward the great Badari.

verses.text:
ते त्वाशुगतिभिर्वीरा राक्षसैस्तैर्महाबलैः ।
उह्यमाना ययुः शीघ्रं महदध्वानमल्पवत् ॥

meaning.en: Carried by those mighty demons of swift pace, those heroes quickly passed over a long road as if it were short.

verses.text:
देशान्म्लेच्छगणाकीर्णान्नानारत्नाकरायुतान् ।
ददृशुर्गिरिपादांश्च नानाधातुसमाचितान् ॥

meaning.en: They saw regions crowded with hosts of barbarians and with mines of many gems, and foothills rich with many minerals.

verses.text:
विद्याधरगणाकीर्णान्युतान्वानरकिंनरैः ।
तथा किंपुरुषैश्चैव गन्धर्वैश्च समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: These were crowded with hosts of Vidyadharas, with monkeys and kinnaras, and with Kimpurushas and gandharvas on all sides.

verses.text:
नदीजालसमाकीर्णान्नानापक्षिरुताकुलान् ।
नानाविधैर्मृगैर्जुष्टान्वानरैश्चोपशोभितान् ॥

meaning.en: They were threaded with networks of rivers, noisy with the cries of many birds, frequented by many kinds of animals and adorned with monkeys.

verses.text:
ते व्यतीत्य बहून्देशानुत्तरांश्च कुरूनपि ।
ददृशुर्विविधाश्चर्यं कैलासं पर्वतोत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Crossing many regions, and the northern Kurus too, they saw Kailasa, the best of mountains, of manifold wonders.

verses.text:
तस्याभ्याशे तु ददृशुर्नरनारायणाश्रमम् ।
उपेतं पादपैर्दिव्यैः सदापुष्पफलोपगैः ॥

meaning.en: Near it they saw the hermitage of Nara and Narayana, adorned with divine trees always in flower and fruit.

verses.text:
ददृशुस्तां च बदरीं वृत्तस्कन्धां मनोरमाम् ।
स्निग्धामविरलच्छायां श्रिया परमया युताम् ॥

meaning.en: They saw that Badari tree, round-trunked and lovely, smooth, with thick shade, of supreme splendour.

verses.text:
पत्रैः स्निग्धैरविरलैरुपेतां मृदुभिः शुभाम् ।
विशालशाखां विस्तीर्णामतिद्युतिसमन्विताम् ॥

meaning.en: It was fair, with smooth, dense, soft leaves, with broad spreading branches, and of great radiance.

verses.text:
फलैरुपचितैर्दिव्यैराचितां स्वादुभिर्भृशम् ।
मधुस्रवैः सदा दिव्यां महर्षिगणसेविताम् ।
मदप्रमुदितैर्नित्यं नानाद्विजगणैर्युताम् ॥

meaning.en: It was loaded with heavy, divine, very sweet fruit dripping honey, divine, frequented by hosts of great seers, and always with flocks of birds joyful with delight.

verses.text:
अदंशमशके देशे बहुमूलफलोदके ।
नीलशाद्वलसंछन्ने देवगन्धर्वसेविते ॥

meaning.en: The place was free of gnats and mosquitoes, with abundant roots, fruits and water, covered with blue grass, and frequented by gods and gandharvas.

verses.text:
सुसमीकृतभूभागे स्वभावविहिते शुभे ।
जातां हिममृदुस्पर्शे देशेऽपहतकण्टके ॥

meaning.en: The ground there was level, naturally formed, auspicious, with a soft cool touch, and free of thorns.

verses.text:
तामुपेत्य महात्मानः सह तैर्ब्राह्मणर्षभैः ।
अवतेरुस्ततः सर्वे राक्षसस्कन्धतः शनैः ॥

meaning.en: Reaching it, the great-souled ones with the best of brahmins slowly climbed down from the demons' shoulders.

verses.text:
ततस्तमाश्रमं पुण्यं नरनारायणाश्रितम् ।
ददृशुः पाण्डवा राजन्सहिता द्विजपुंगवैः ॥

meaning.en: Then, with the best of brahmins, the Pandavas saw that holy hermitage of Nara and Narayana, king.

verses.text:
तमसा रहितं पुण्यमनामृष्टं रवेः करैः ।
क्षुत्तृट्शीतोष्णदोषैश्च वर्जितं शोकनाशनम् ॥

meaning.en: It was free of darkness, holy, untouched by the sun's rays, free of the troubles of hunger, thirst, cold and heat, and destroying sorrow.

verses.text:
महर्षिगणसंबाधं ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समन्वितम् ।
दुष्प्रवेशं महाराज नरैर्धर्मबहिष्कृतैः ॥

meaning.en: It was crowded with groups of great seers, full of the splendour of Brahman, hard to enter, great king, for men outside dharma.

verses.text:
बलिहोमार्चितं दिव्यं सुसंमृष्टानुलेपनम् ।
दिव्यपुष्पोपहारैश्च सर्वतोऽभिविराजितम् ॥

meaning.en: It was divine, worshipped with offerings and oblations, well swept and plastered, and shining on every side with offerings of divine flowers.

verses.text:
विशालैरग्निशरणैः स्रुग्भाण्डैराचितं शुभैः ।
महद्भिस्तोयकलशैः कठिनैश्चोपशोभितम् ।
शरण्यं सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्मघोषनिनादितम् ॥

meaning.en: It was filled with large fire-halls and auspicious sacrificial ladles and vessels, adorned with great water jars and firm staves, a refuge for all beings, echoing with the chanting of Brahman.

verses.text:
दिव्यमाश्रयणीयं तमाश्रमं श्रमनाशनम् ।
श्रिया युतमनिर्देश्यं देवचर्योपशोभितम् ॥

meaning.en: It was divine, a place to take refuge in, a remover of weariness, endowed with splendour, indescribable, adorned with the conduct of the gods.

verses.text:
फलमूलाशनैर्दान्तैश्चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरैः ।
सूर्यवैश्वानरसमैस्तपसा भावितात्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: It was filled with self-controlled men who ate fruits and roots, wore bark and black antelope skins, and whose souls were refined by austerity, equal to the sun and fire.

verses.text:
महर्षिभिर्मोक्षपरैर्यतिभिर्नियतेन्द्रियैः ।
ब्रह्मभूतैर्महाभागैरुपेतं ब्रह्मवादिभिः ॥

meaning.en: It was filled with great seers devoted to liberation, ascetics with restrained senses, fortunate men who had become Brahman, and speakers of Brahman.

verses.text:
सोऽभ्यगच्छन्महातेजास्तानृषीन्नियतः शुचिः ।
भ्रातृभिः सहितो धीमान्धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: The wise son of Dharma, Yudhishthira, of great radiance, disciplined and pure, went with his brothers to those seers.

verses.text:
दिव्यज्ञानोपपन्नास्ते दृष्ट्वा प्राप्तं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
अभ्यगच्छन्त सुप्रीताः सर्व एव महर्षयः ।
आशीर्वादान्प्रयुञ्जानाः स्वाध्यायनिरता भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Yudhishthira arrived, all those great seers, endowed with divine knowledge, came toward him very gladly, giving blessings, intent on their recitations.

verses.text:
प्रीतास्ते तस्य सत्कारं विधिना पावकोपमाः ।
उपाजह्रुश्च सलिलं पुष्पमूलफलं शुचि ॥

meaning.en: Pleased, those seers, who were like fire, gave him a proper welcome and brought water, flowers, roots and pure fruit.

verses.text:
स तैः प्रीत्याथ सत्कारमुपनीतं महर्षिभिः ।
प्रयतः प्रतिगृह्याथ धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Receiving the honour brought to him lovingly by those great seers, Yudhishthira, son of Dharma, accepted it reverently.

verses.text:
तं शक्रसदनप्रख्यं दिव्यगन्धं मनोरमम् ।
प्रीतः स्वर्गोपमं पुण्यं पाण्डवः सह कृष्णया ॥

meaning.en: That place was like Indra's abode, lovely and divinely fragrant, holy and like heaven, and the Pandava, glad, entered it with Krishna.

verses.text:
विवेश शोभया युक्तं भ्रातृभिश्च सहानघ ।
ब्राह्मणैर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैश्च सहाच्युतः ॥

meaning.en: He, with his brothers, entered it in all its beauty, sinless one, with brahmins who had mastered the Vedas and their limbs.

verses.text:
तत्रापश्यत्स धर्मात्मा देवदेवर्षिपूजितम् ।
नरनारायणस्थानं भागीरथ्योपशोभितम् ॥

meaning.en: There the righteous king saw the abode of Nara and Narayana, honoured by gods and divine seers and adorned by the Bhagirathi.

verses.text:
मधुस्रवफलां दिव्यां महर्षिगणसेविताम् ।
तामुपेत्य महात्मानस्तेऽवसन्ब्राह्मणैः सह ॥

meaning.en: It was divine, its fruits dripping honey, frequented by hosts of great seers. Coming to it, the great-souled ones lived there with the brahmins.

verses.text:
आलोकयन्तो मैनाकं नानाद्विजगणायुतम् ।
हिरण्यशिखरं चैव तच्च बिन्दुसरः शिवम् ॥

meaning.en: Looking at Mainaka, full of flocks of many birds, at the golden-peaked mountain and the lovely lake Bindu,

verses.text:
भागीरथीं सुतीर्थां च शीतामलजलां शिवाम् ।
मणिप्रवालप्रस्तारां पादपैरुपशोभिताम् ॥

meaning.en: and the Bhagirathi with its fine fords, cool and pure and gentle, strewn with gems and coral, adorned with trees,

verses.text:
दिव्यपुष्पसमाकीर्णां मनसः प्रीतिवर्धनीम् ।
वीक्षमाणा महात्मानो विजह्रुस्तत्र पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: and strewn with divine flowers, increasing the heart's delight, the great-souled Pandavas, looking about, enjoyed themselves there.

verses.text:
तत्र देवान्पितॄंश्चैव तर्पयन्तः पुनः पुनः ।
ब्राह्मणैः सहिता वीरा न्यवसन्पुरुषर्षभाः ॥

meaning.en: There, offering libations again and again to the gods and the fathers, those heroes, bulls among men, lived with the brahmins.

verses.text:
कृष्णायास्तत्र पश्यन्तः क्रीडितान्यमरप्रभाः ।
विचित्राणि नरव्याघ्रा रेमिरे तत्र पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: Watching Krishna's play there, those tigers among men, radiant as immortals, delighted in the wonderful scenes.
